zh.title: GE 航太以117.5億美元收購鑄件供應商CPP
zh.summary: GE航太收購CPP；交易預計2027下半年完成
body: GE Aerospace（GE航太）於2026年9月8日宣布，已同意以117.5億美元收購其鑄件供應商Consolidated Precision Products（CPP），直接取得該零件類別的所有權，此類零件過去限制了業界的引擎產出。
此項交易將從私募投資公司Warburg Pincus與Berkshire Partners手中買下CPP，並預計於2027年下半年完成交割，尚待監管機關批准及其他慣例成交條件。GE航太表示，將以70億美元現金及餘額的新增債務支付，且不會改變其資本配置計畫。
總部位於俄亥俄州克里夫蘭（Cleveland）的CPP成立於1991年，專門生產用於商用與軍用飛機、武器系統、直升機、飛彈及工業燃氣渦輪機的超合金、鈦、鋁、鎂及鋼材精密及精密砂心鑄件。該公司雇有約6,600人，分布在超過20座工廠，而GE航太為其客戶已超過15年。
在向美國證券交易委員會（SEC）提交的投資人簡報中，GE Aerospace指出，CPP供應LEAP、GEnx、T700、F110及F404引擎的鑄件，並預測其自身的葉片需求（以零件數量計算）在2026年至2030年間，將在商用引擎、售後市場及防衛領域中成長超過30%。
GE Aerospace以約2027年EBITDA的18倍來評價CPP，其中包含預期約2億美元的淨綜效，若不含綜效，則為約26倍。若以這些倍數套用至收購價格，CPP在2027年的息稅前項目估約為47.5億美元。公司表示，預期此收購自第一年起將為調整後每股盈餘與自由現金流量貢獻正面，並於五年後產生兩位數的投入資本報酬。
此項收購與歐洲的先例相呼應：空中巴士（Airbus）與Safran於2026年6月25日同意自Tikehau Capital手中收購Aubert et Duval，這兩家集團因而完全掌握一家不易取代的法國金屬與超級合金生產商。

en.title: GE Aerospace to buy engine castings supplier CPP for $11.75 billion
en.summary: GE Aerospace signs deal to acquire CPP for $11.75 billion; closure expected in H2 2027 pending approvals
body: GE Aerospace has agreed to acquire Consolidated Precision Products (CPP), one of its own castings suppliers, for $11.75 billion, taking direct ownership of a component category that has constrained engine output across the industry.

The company announced the signed agreement on September 8, 2026. It is purchasing CPP from private investment firms Warburg Pincus and Berkshire Partners and expects the transaction to close in the second half of 2027, subject to regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions. GE Aerospace said that it will fund the purchase with $7 billion in cash and the remainder in new debt, with no change to its capital allocation plans.

Founded in 1991, Cleveland, Ohio-based CPP specializes in producing investment and precision facility castings in superalloy, titanium, aluminum, magnesium and steel for commercial and military aircraft, weapon systems, helicopters, missiles and industrial gas turbines. The company employs roughly 6,600 people across more than 20 facilities, and GE Aerospace has been a customer for over 15 years.

In an investor presentation filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), GE Aerospace noted that CPP supplies castings for the LEAP, GEnx, T700, F110 and F404 engines, and projected that its own airfoil demand, measured in number of parts, would grow by more than 30% between 2026 and 2030 across commercial engines, aftermarket and defense.

GE Aerospace valued CPP at approximately 18 times 2027 EBITDA, including expected net synergies of about $200 million, or approximately 26 times without them. Applied to the purchase price, those multiples imply CPP earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization of roughly $450 million in 2027 before synergies, against the approximately $2 billion of 2027 revenue that the presentation attributes to the company.

The purchase follows a comparable move in Europe, where Airbus and Safran agreed on June 25, 2026, to buy Tikehau Capital out of Aubert and Duval, leaving the two groups in full control of a French metals and superalloys producer neither could easily replace.

zh.title: 俄羅斯UAC埃及航展首展Su-57E雙新型武器
zh.summary: UAC於埃及航展首展S-71M與S-71K兩種空射武器
body: 俄羅斯聯合航空製造公司（United Aircraft Corporation，UAC）宣布，將於2026年9月8日在埃及阿拉曼國際機場（DBB）舉行的阿拉曼國際航展，首度展出兩種用於蘇愷Su-57E的空射武器，分別為S-71M與S-71K。
UAC表示，S-71K（代號Kovyor）是空射巡弋飛彈，以傳統航空炸彈作為彈頭；S-71M（代號Monokhrom）則設計用於自主目標搜索與接戰。聲明未提供武器的尺寸、射程或酬載數據。
Su-57E已參加飛行展示與靜態展示。俄羅斯國防出口公司（Rosoboronexport）表示，該戰機將搭配RVV-MD2與RVV-BD空對空飛彈，以及霧-38MLE、霧-69巡弋飛彈和霧-58UShKE反輻射飛彈。

en.title: Russia's UAC to debut two new Su-57E weapons at Egypt airshow
en.summary: UAC to debut S-71M and S-71K air-launched weapons for Su-57E at Egypt airshow
body: Russia's United Aircraft Corporation (UAC) has announced that it will display two air-launched weapons for the Sukhoi Su-57E for the first time at the El Alamein International Airshow 2026, which opened on September 8, 2026, at El Alamein International Airport (DBB) in Egypt.
UAC identified the weapons as the S-71M and S-71K, both intended for fifth-generation fighters. The announcement stated no dimensions, range, or payload figures.

The S-71K is an air-launched cruise missile that incorporates a conventional aircraft bomb as its warhead. The S-71M is intended to add autonomous target search and engagement. The Su-57E is taking part in the flying program as well as being on static display.
